definition.name: Signal Runner
definition.description: A local Canvas courier game assembled from graph-owned seeded courses and difficulty rules. Dodge barriers, collect signals, and reach the uplink. No services, credentials, or paid calls.

CARRY THE SIGNAL.
FIND THE OPEN LANE.

SIGNALS 0HULL 3TIME 0BEST 0
This game requires Canvas. Use the buttons below to steer.
Courier briefing

Bring the packets home.

Dodge the red barriers. Collect the diamond signals. Reach the finish with the required signal count before time runs out.

Ready to connect.

STEER / ← → or A D
PAUSE / Space or button
TOUCH / left and right buttons

Built by the graph.

The manifest contains every barrier, signal, and rule. Restart replays the same course; changing it requires editing the graph and rerunning.

No accounts, APIs, sound, or network requests. Best score lasts only while this page is open. This is a visual reaction game; reduced motion removes decorative streaks but not essential scrolling.
